scope: Local sandbox only; not deployment, release, Exa or fixed resource/latency promise.
sample_scope: 3 fresh Python/browser/empty-cache lifetimes, 9 warm calls/workload; OS filesystem cache and host load not controlled; p95 is max for n=9.
stage_scope: Direct fixed-label inclusive spans; phases overlap, do not sum across phases or infer causal attribution solely from end-to-end differences. Serialization excludes complete SDK/HTTP transport.
queue_scope: 9 paired active+two-contender episodes, active=1 capacity=1 wait=150ms. Queue phase identity shared, not per-client; visit deltas overlap. Exact unordered queue_full+queue_timeout in every episode.
startup_scope: Bootstrap/import timer excludes interpreter initialization. MCP starts browser warmup asynchronously: initial fetch overlaps startup. Initial startup spans below are initialization-labeled only; additional brief start attempts during MCP session close after simulated idle expiry are NOT cold-ready or queue samples.
idle_rss_scope: 20ms sampled Python client/server/fixture plus descendants, excludes coordinator; shared pages double-counted, short peaks may be missed. Idle expiry simulated via release Clock, not real 1h wall idle.
contracts_verified: Same corpus, dependencies, canonical versions, freshness states, outcomes, initial/expanded coverage, highlight/omission/truncation counts and budgets; hits/expansion zero visits; exact quotes asserted after refresh in each harness; zero surviving observed descendants.
unfinished_acceptance: Repeated deployment-hardware comparison at actual CPU/memory/egress/storage settings; operator must supply target node, baseline/candidate image digests and limits.
Parent final integrated suite, independent two-axis reviews and merger.
